title: Adaptive LLM Growth and MoE Upcycling
goal: Evaluate and prototype controlled growth of transformer LLMs from small dense baselines through depth/width expansion and MoE upcycling, with optional evidence-driven growth and pruning.
purpose: Research-to-MVP track; prioritize reproducible compute-normalized evidence over claims of automatic intelligence improvement.
assumptions: Ananta is orchestration and evaluation layer, not a replacement for an established pretraining framework.
Target 3B-to-30B is an exploratory scaling goal, not a locally feasible MVP or promised result.

source_review.kind: Preliminary repo inspection; runtime integrations not audited

tasks.title: Research and baseline
tasks.description: Inventory Ananta training integrations and licenses; compare progressive depth/width growth, Net2Net, MoE upcycling and expert addition; record reproducible references.
acceptance_criteria: Define fixed-size and train-from-scratch baselines plus matched token and FLOP budgets.
tasks.progress_note: Inventory/references and explicit tiny-reference architecture documented; Torch port reuses Research infrastructure.

tasks.title: Experiment contract
tasks.description: Define model configs, dataset provenance, split contamination checks, seeds, compute budget and success thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Track active/total parameters, step FLOPs, tokens/sec, quality, VRAM/RAM, optimizer memory and regressions.
tasks.progress_note: Closed model/budget contract; bilingual splits, contamination checks, seeded token/FLOP-controlled baselines and resource metrics.

tasks.title: Small-scale prototype
tasks.description: Implement a framework-agnostic trainer adapter with PyTorch/Transformers optional backends and checkpoint/resume.
acceptance_criteria: Train a tiny reference model first, no claims of 3B training on local hardware.
tasks.progress_note: Real CPU/CUDA tiny-transformer training, injected trainer port and safetensors checkpoint/resume tested. General HF surgery explicitly unsupported.

tasks.title: Depth growth
tasks.description: Implement function-preserving or approximately preserving layer insertion with shape checks.
acceptance_criteria: Measure immediate loss perturbation and recovery vs scratch baseline.
tasks.progress_note: Identity residual insertion preserves logits; immediate perturbation/recovery and scratch arms measured.

tasks.title: Width growth
tasks.description: Implement widening for embeddings, attention projections and MLP with optimizer-state migration.
acceptance_criteria: Document unsupported architectures and deterministic failure instead of silent corruption.
tasks.progress_note: Reference embedding/attention/MLP widening preserves function and migrates Adam moments; unsupported architectures fail explicitly.

tasks.title: MoE upcycling
tasks.description: Prototype dense-to-MoE expert cloning and specialization with load-balancing and router initialization.
acceptance_criteria: Measure expert collapse, utilization, active parameters, memory and throughput.
tasks.progress_note: Sparse selected-token experts, seeded router, load-balancing loss, utilization/collapse and throughput metrics implemented.

tasks.title: Adaptive controller
tasks.description: Implement opt-in budget-aware growth policy driven by validation plateau, gradient signals and expert utilization.
acceptance_criteria: Use cooldown, hysteresis, audit logs, bounded changes and reproducible decisions; do not claim autonomous growth is proven.
tasks.progress_note: Hub-owned opt-in plateau/gradient/utilization/cooldown/budget proposals and content-free audited decision service; no Worker scheduling.

tasks.title: Pruning and rollback
tasks.description: Evaluate selective expert pruning and checkpoint rollback under quality regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve model/tokenizer compatibility, optimizer state and immutable experiment lineage.
tasks.progress_note: Selective pruning plus Adam migration, immutable parent checkpoints, exact resume and verified-checkpoint regression rollback policy tested.

tasks.title: Ananta integration
tasks.description: Integrate experiments with existing Ananta todo/agent workflows via adapters, avoiding a new monolithic training stack.
acceptance_criteria: Provide CLI dry-run, isolated sandbox execution, configurable GPU/CPU offload, no uncontrolled cloud spend.
tasks.progress_note: Additive adaptive_growth Research stage uses existing Registry admission, closed assignment/result paths and checkpoint manager. CPU/CUDA CLI observations run in bounded sandbox; automatic release denied.

tasks.title: Evaluation and gate
tasks.description: Run multilingual German/English benchmarks, retention, safety regressions, data-efficiency and held-out tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Publish matched-compute ablations and a go/no-go report; no benefit claims without measured confidence.
tasks.progress_note: 42 CPU and 42 CUDA reference arms, bilingual loss/retention, authored safety/grounding/tasks and confidence intervals recorded. Remaining: substantive real-world frozen multilingual datasets and evidence-grounded scaling/benefit evaluation; tiny synthetic probes do not establish intelligence or release eligibility.

tasks.title: Documentation and CI
tasks.description: Add unit/property tests for tensor shapes, deterministic expansion, resume and regression; document licensing.
acceptance_criteria: CI smoke tests on CPU, optional GPU jobs, usage guide and architecture decision record.
tasks.progress_note: CPU CI job, real tensor invariance/causality/optimizer/resume tests, Hub-issued evidence integration, usage and architecture guide.

notes: Use matched compute and token controls to avoid misleading growth comparisons.
No unrestricted self-modification or automatic spending.
All implementations must follow existing Ananta conventions, SOLID and TDD.

implementation_review.note: Only tasks whose own criteria are fulfilled are done. Remaining real-world, deployment and exhaustive hardware acceptance is explicitly partial; no forged SRC/RUN identities or model-benefit claims.
